statements.text: Relative to Charu, the seat is at rest.
Relative to Rohan on the footpath, the seat is in motion.
Rest and motion do not depend on a chosen reference point.

stem:
Charu rides a bicycle past a parked auto. To Charu, the bicycle seat looks still. To Rohan standing on the footpath, the same seat moves past with the bicycle.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Motion or rest depends on the reference point: the seat is at rest relative to Charu and in motion relative to Rohan. Saying reference does not matter makes statement 3 false.
